 Apple released new updates for Apple TV, HomeUnder the Vision Pro 
 All about Apple 
 J. Filip Jiří Filip 
 26. 10. 2026 
 0 
 Apple today started the update distribution in a big way. In addition to the new versions MacOS whether watchOS because a little while ago he also released tvOS 27.2, HomePod Software 27.2 to visionOS 27.2. And although individual updates differ in the number of new features, especially owners Apple TV a HomePods have a lot to look forward to. The Californian giant is bringing new surround sound options, interesting lighting effects and other improvements. Siri.
 HomePods get lighting effects and surround sound 
 One of the most interesting news HomePod Software 27.2 is undoubtedly the Sound Glow feature, which is now also coming to existing HomePods and HomePod mini. It allows the top touch surface of the speaker to pulse in color to the rhythm of the music being played, with the colors used based on the cover of a specific album. Moreover, the function works not only with music, but also with podcasts or ambient sounds from Appyou.
 An interesting new feature is also the ability to set HomePod as the Mac's default speaker. Apple Additionally, it has added a Lock Controls feature that allows you to disable the touch controls on the top of the speaker. This can be useful, for example, in households with small children.

 Apple TV can handle up to four HomePods at once 
 tvOS 27.2 also brings big changes. Its main attraction is support for surround sound via four HomePods, thanks to which it will be possible to create a significantly more impressive home theater than before. Apple for example, it counts with a set of four HomePods mini 2, four HomeSecond generation pods or combinations of two.
 The catch, however, is that the new product requires the upcoming fourth generation Apple TV 4K, which will go on sale only on November 13. Owners of older Apple TV so unfortunately they will not use this option. New HomeUnder mini 2 will then hit the market on October 30th.

 Owners receive the smallest portion of news this time Apple Vision Pro. Update visionOS 27.2 primarily brings expanded language support Siri AI that can now handle francUzbek, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish. In addition Apple worked on bug fixes and overall system tuning.
